items.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
items.description: An elf mage sets out on a journey to understand mortals and fulfill the last wishes of her fallen comrades decades after their victory over the Demon King.

items.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
items.description: A high school student joins a secret organization of sorcerers to eliminate a powerful Curse named Ryomen Sukuna, of whom he becomes the host.

items.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
items.description: A youth begins a quest to fight demons and turn his sister, who was transformed into a demon, back into a human.
